title: Machine learning identifies SIK1 as an epilepsy driver validated in rat models
summary: Machine-learning screening of LKB1-pathway genes in GEO data prioritized SIK1. In a PTZ-induced rat epilepsy model, SIK1 knockdown delayed seizures and shortened their duration, whereas overexpression worsened severity. The paper abstract also reports that restoring downstream NR4A2 counteracted SIK1-related effects in rescue and neuronal experiments. These are preclinical findings, not evidence of treatment efficacy in people. This summary is limited to the abstract and publication metadata.
ai_technology: Machine learning screening of LKB1 pathway genes on GEO dataset GSE143272
organization: The First People's Hospital of Qinzhou; The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University

evidence.tested: Gene prioritization from GEO data followed by rat SIK1 perturbations, NR4A2 rescue and neuronal electrophysiology.
evidence.unknown: Source checking does not establish independent confirmation. Review date: 2026-11-15.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning screened LKB1 pathway genes and ranked SIK1 as the top epilepsy risk gene for experimental follow-up.
